pages.text: Open the Curios inventory beside your normal inventory, or use its configurable key binding. Reforged supplies a Head, Necklace, Hands, Ring, Belt, Charm and general Curio slot. Right-click an accessory to equip an empty compatible slot. Its effects require it to be worn.

Hecate's Visage uses Head. Nazar, Triskelion and Vampiric Amulet use Necklace slots. Glutton's Sash and Girdle of the Dryads use Belt; Fortune's Favor uses Charm. Horseshoe, Token of Remedies and Hellish Bauble are universal trinkets. Curios also accepts every accessory in a general Curio slot.

Binding Curse prevents normal removal, with a creative-mode exception. Extra copies of the same accessory do not multiply periodic effects or damage protection. Powered effects need a charged, carried Grimoire. Curios handles slot persistence and synchronization.
